Picky-owned async providers, extracted from the published npm registry tarballs.
Source repository: https://github.com/Jonghakseo/pi-extension (subagent fix commit 40e4976)

Reproduce with: npm pack @ryan_nookpi/pi-extension-bash-async@0.2.4 @ryan_nookpi/pi-extension-subagent@0.5.9
The checked-in async-task-providers.lock.json pins every extracted package file byte.
Do not replace these with a developer checkout, version-only npm lookup, or an unqualified tarball.
